changelog:
Live transport controls, checked on a phone.

WHAT CHANGED

- Nothing new to learn: this release completes the live controls that 0.5.5 introduced, now measured on a real phone with a real provider rather than only in tests. Drag the bar back through up to the whole window you have kept, and the readout tells you where you are; turn the phone and you stay there; Back to live lands at now, and checks that it did.
- Behind the scenes, the app records that it will not cache live video by its web address on these providers, because one of them changes the content behind an address without changing the address. Pause and rewind keeps using its own recording instead, which is immune to that.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything from 0.5.5.1: Continue watching, the refresh that changes only what changed, and the licences page.

NOT YET

- Rewinding a channel your provider sends as an HLS playlist. Those still play live only.
